# Material Color Utilities — Google LLC

[Upstream](https://github.com/material-foundation/material-color-utilities), commit `bd811e4ca2ab94c4ce3cadc89c19b1820b9704b3`.

Subset: `java/hct/{Hct,HctSolver,Cam16,ViewingConditions}` and `java/utils/{ColorUtils,MathUtils}`.

Package/import namespaces are adapted for Air Home. The color algorithms remain in upstream Java.

[Apache-2.0 license](LICENSE). An identical [copy](../../src/main/assets/third-party/material-color-utilities/LICENSE) is packaged in the TV APK.
